Django News Application
  • Building this documentation

Building this documentation

The rendered HTML is already in the repository at docs/_build/html/. To read it, open docs/_build/html/index.html in a browser. You only need to rebuild it after changing the documentation or the docstrings.

Rebuild on Windows (PowerShell)

From the project root:

.\build_docs.ps1

The script:

  1. Finds Python 3.12 (py -3.12, then python, then python3).

  2. Creates the .venv virtual environment if it does not exist.

  3. Installs requirements.txt into .venv if any required package is missing.

  4. Runs Sphinx and writes the site to docs/_build/html/.

It works from any folder, and docs\build_docs.ps1 can be run directly. A database server is not required. Use -Clean to delete the previous output first:

.\build_docs.ps1 -Clean

If PowerShell blocks the script, run:

powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\build_docs.ps1

Rebuild on macOS / Linux

sh docs/build_docs.sh

Rebuild manually

With the virtual environment active and the requirements installed:

python -m sphinx -W --keep-going -b html -d docs/_build/doctrees docs docs/_build/html

Or, from inside docs/, make html (macOS/Linux) or .\make.bat html (Windows).

-W turns warnings into errors so problems are not missed.

Source layout

docs/
    conf.py                   Sphinx configuration
    index.rst                 Home page and table of contents
    *.rst                     User guide pages
    api/index.rst             API reference (autosummary)
    api/generated/            Pages generated by autosummary
    _static/custom.css        Small style tweaks
    _templates/autosummary/   Template for generated module pages
    Makefile, make.bat        Standard Sphinx build helpers
    build_docs.ps1/.sh        One-step build scripts
    _build/html/              Rendered HTML (committed)

The API reference is generated from the docstrings in the source code with sphinx.ext.autodoc and sphinx.ext.autosummary. Docstrings use the Google style, which sphinx.ext.napoleon converts for Sphinx.
